resolution.question: Will the McCain and Obama campaigns both publicly confirm their candidates' participation in the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi before the scheduled debate day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff on 2008-09-26T12:00:00-05:00, the persistent event history shows that both the McCain campaign and the Obama campaign have issued a public statement (e.g., press release, official announcement) confirming their candidate's participation in the debate. Otherwise resolve NO.
